title: Polynomial-time prefix truncation
statement: Let $o$ assign a natural number to each bit string, and let $S$ be a function from bit strings to bit strings. If the unary string of length $o(y)$ is polynomial-time computable as a function of $y$, and $S$ is polynomial-time computable, then the function sending $y$ to the prefix of $S(y)$ of length $o(y)$ is polynomial-time computable.
